quotes.text: Instead, direct lake queries the data where it sits in one lake with no refresh needed, no duplication and the data is always current and blazing fast.

takeaways: Microsoft Fabric is a unified SaaS data and analytics platform that brings data engineering, integration, warehousing, real-time analytics and BI together under one login.
OneLake is the single data lake per tenant in open Delta Parquet format, and shortcuts let you reference external data without copying it.
Power BI in Fabric reads OneLake data directly via Direct Lake, while Purview sensitivity labels, DLP and domains provide governance from the start.
hook: Everyone talks about Microsoft Fabric, but few can explain what it actually is. This episode walks business and IT folks through OneLake, lakehouses, warehouses, data integration, real-time intelligence and Power BI in plain English. You will understand how the pieces fit together and why one copy of data changes everything.
